stations.title: Tense Timeline｜時態時間線
stations.target: 辨認過去敘事、直接說話及未來志願。

items.prompt: Last Friday, Grace ___ (go) to a care home.
items.feedback_zh: Last Friday 是過去時間。
items.hint_zh: 先找時間提示，再判斷這是敘事、直接說話，還是未來計劃。

items.prompt: She ___ (meet) a volunteer at the door.
items.feedback_zh: 敘事承接上題的過去時間。
items.hint_zh: 先找時間提示，再判斷這是敘事、直接說話，還是未來計劃。

items.prompt: The volunteer ___ (give) her a storybook.
items.feedback_zh: give 的過去式是 gave。
items.hint_zh: 先找時間提示，再判斷這是敘事、直接說話，還是未來計劃。

items.prompt: After Grace ___ (read) the story, the visitors clapped.
items.feedback_zh: 這裏是過去式 read，拼寫不變，讀音為 /red/。
items.hint_zh: 先找時間提示，再判斷這是敘事、直接說話，還是未來計劃。

items.prompt: At first, she ___ nervous.
items.feedback_zh: 單數主語 she，過去敘事用 was。
items.hint_zh: 先找時間提示，再判斷這是敘事、直接說話，還是未來計劃。

items.prompt: The volunteer said, “You ___ speak slowly.”
items.feedback_zh: 直接說話可用 can；不要把引號內所有動詞改成過去式。
items.hint_zh: 先找時間提示，再判斷這是敘事、直接說話，還是未來計劃。

items.prompt: My future plan: If I become a coach, I ___ children.
items.feedback_zh: 未來計劃：If + 現在式，主句 will + 原形。
items.hint_zh: 先找時間提示，再判斷這是敘事、直接說話，還是未來計劃。

items.prompt: Keep the whole story in the past: Last year, Tim trained hard. In the end, he ___ more confident.
items.feedback_zh: 本題指定全段維持過去敘事。
items.hint_zh: 先找時間提示，再判斷這是敘事、直接說話，還是未來計劃。

stations.title: Sentence Clinic｜句子診所
stations.target: 穩定動詞搭配及常用表達；a/an、形容詞副詞為鞏固題。

items.prompt: Amy wanted ___ a story to her grandmother.
items.feedback_zh: want 後接 to + 原形。
items.hint_zh: 先找主要動詞及其後的結構，或判斷空格要修飾哪個字。

items.prompt: She asked her brother ___ to her.
items.feedback_zh: ask + 人 + to + 原形。
items.hint_zh: 先找主要動詞及其後的結構，或判斷空格要修飾哪個字。

items.prompt: The coach taught Jack ___ safely.
items.feedback_zh: teach + 人 + to + 原形。
items.hint_zh: 先找主要動詞及其後的結構，或判斷空格要修飾哪個字。

items.prompt: We did half an hour ___ exercise.
items.feedback_zh: 時間量 + of + exercise。
items.hint_zh: 先找主要動詞及其後的結構，或判斷空格要修飾哪個字。

items.prompt: Choose the phrase meaning 每天: I practised ___.
items.feedback_zh: every day 表每天；everyday 為形容詞。
items.hint_zh: 先找主要動詞及其後的結構，或判斷空格要修飾哪個字。

items.prompt: She had ___ idea for helping her neighbour.
items.feedback_zh: idea 以元音音素開頭，前用 an。
items.hint_zh: 先找主要動詞及其後的結構，或判斷空格要修飾哪個字。

items.prompt: They prepared a ___ meal.
items.feedback_zh: healthy 為形容詞，修飾名詞 meal。
items.hint_zh: 先找主要動詞及其後的結構，或判斷空格要修飾哪個字。

items.prompt: They wanted to eat ___.
items.feedback_zh: 這裏用副詞修飾 eat。
items.hint_zh: 先找主要動詞及其後的結構，或判斷空格要修飾哪個字。

stations.title: Cause and Result｜連接與因果
stations.target: 用連接詞表時間、原因、結果及轉折。

items.prompt: Dan asked for help ___ he did not know how to use the brakes.
items.feedback_zh: 後半句說明求助的原因。
items.hint_zh: 先判斷兩部分是原因、結果、轉折，還是先後次序。

items.prompt: He could not stop safely, ___ he practised with his uncle.
items.feedback_zh: 後半句是因應困難的行動／結果。
items.hint_zh: 先判斷兩部分是原因、結果、轉折，還是先後次序。

items.prompt: Show contrast: ___ he felt nervous, he tried the easy route.
items.feedback_zh: 緊張但仍嘗試，屬轉折。
items.hint_zh: 先判斷兩部分是原因、結果、轉折，還是先後次序。

items.prompt: He checked his bicycle ___ he started riding.
items.feedback_zh: 先檢查，後騎車。
items.hint_zh: 先判斷兩部分是原因、結果、轉折，還是先後次序。

items.prompt: ___ he stopped, he got off the bicycle.
items.feedback_zh: 先停車，後下車。
items.hint_zh: 先判斷兩部分是原因、結果、轉折，還是先後次序。

items.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
items.answer: Because it was wet, they practised indoors.
items.feedback_zh: because 與 so 不在這個句式中重複使用。
options: Because it was wet, so they practised indoors.
Because it was wet, they practised indoors.
It was wet because so indoors.
items.hint_zh: 先判斷兩部分是原因、結果、轉折，還是先後次序。

items.prompt: Choose the sentence with a clear result.
items.answer: She practised speaking clearly, so the listeners could hear her.
items.feedback_zh: 結果須回應所做的練習。
options: She practised speaking clearly, so the listeners could hear her.
She practised speaking clearly, so her bicycle was blue.
She practised speaking clearly, so last Tuesday.
items.hint_zh: 先判斷兩部分是原因、結果、轉折，還是先後次序。

items.prompt: Join with although: “Max was tired. He finished checking his bag.”
items.answer: Although Max was tired, he finished checking his bag.
items.feedback_zh: Although 引轉折；保留原來意思。
accepted_answers: Max finished checking his bag although he was tired.
items.hint_zh: 先判斷兩部分是原因、結果、轉折，還是先後次序。

stations.title: Four-panel Planner｜3D 四格計劃
stations.target: 先訂目標，拆解困難與行動，再決定結果。

items.prompt: In the 3D planner, where does “Mia wanted to help at a book stall” belong?
items.feedback_zh: Define 先訂人物及目標。
items.hint_zh: 先問：這句在說目標、解決方法，還是最後的改變？

items.prompt: Where does “She mixed up the prices, so she asked a teacher for help” belong?
items.feedback_zh: Decompose 寫困難、求助及方法。
items.hint_zh: 先問：這句在說目標、解決方法，還是最後的改變？

items.prompt: Where does “She labelled the books correctly and learnt to check her work” belong?
items.feedback_zh: Discover 交代結果與所學。
items.hint_zh: 先問：這句在說目標、解決方法，還是最後的改變？

items.prompt: Order these events: A. The customers found the prices clear. B. Mia mixed up the prices. C. A teacher showed her how to make labels. D. Mia wanted to help at the stall.
items.feedback_zh: 先目標，再困難、方法及結果。
items.hint_zh: 先問：這句在說目標、解決方法，還是最後的改變？

items.prompt: Which action best solves the price problem?
items.answer: She made clear labels and checked them with the teacher.
items.feedback_zh: 行動必須直接回應價錢混亂。
options: She made clear labels and checked them with the teacher.
items.hint_zh: 先問：這句在說目標、解決方法，還是最後的改變？

items.prompt: Sam could not turn safely. Which plan is safest and most useful?
items.answer: Practise easy turns with an adult in a safe area.
items.feedback_zh: 方法要回應轉彎技能，亦須顧及安全。
options: Ride fast on a busy road.
Practise easy turns with an adult in a safe area.
Skip practice and hope to pass.
items.hint_zh: 先問：這句在說目標、解決方法，還是最後的改變？

items.prompt: Give one possible result after Mia checked the labels. Write one past-tense sentence.
items.answer: Sample: The customers could read the prices clearly.
items.feedback_zh: 教師檢查：結果合理，回應標籤問題，使用完整過去敘事句。
items.hint_zh: 先問：這句在說目標、解決方法，還是最後的改變？

items.prompt: Four panels: a child wanted to help at a stall; prices were confusing; a teacher showed the child how to label books; panel 4 is open. Write a two-sentence plan for panel 4, including a result and a lesson.
items.answer: Sample: The stall ran smoothly after she checked the labels. She learnt that careful preparation helped others.
items.feedback_zh: 教師檢查：有結果及相關所學，不要求與範例完全相同。
items.hint_zh: 先問：這句在說目標、解決方法，還是最後的改變？

stations.title: Endings and Self-check｜結尾與自檢
stations.target: 明確結果、感受、所學；修改重點而非背範文。

items.prompt: Which ending has a result, a feeling and a lesson?
items.answer: She finished the labels, felt proud and learnt to check her work.
items.feedback_zh: 三項俱全，而且與事件有關。
options: She finished the labels, felt proud and learnt to check her work.
items.hint_zh: 找出結果、感受及所學；再檢查是否回應故事，動詞是否配合時間。

items.prompt: Which sentence clearly says the action happened, not just that it was possible?
items.feedback_zh: joined 明確交代已加入；could join 可表示能力或可能。
options: He could join the beginner group.
He wanted to join the beginner group.
items.hint_zh: 找出結果、感受及所學；再檢查是否回應故事，動詞是否配合時間。

items.prompt: Which lesson best fits a story about practising a difficult skill?
items.answer: Patient practice and help could improve her skills.
items.feedback_zh: 所學應回應故事，也不要保證入隊或長高。
options: Patient practice and help could improve her skills.
items.hint_zh: 找出結果、感受及所學；再檢查是否回應故事，動詞是否配合時間。

items.prompt: Fix the tense: “Last year, he practised hard. In the end, he becomes more skilful.”
items.answer: Last year, he practised hard. In the end, he became more skilful.
items.feedback_zh: 明示過去敘事：becomes 改為 became。
items.hint_zh: 找出結果、感受及所學；再檢查是否回應故事，動詞是否配合時間。

items.prompt: A past story includes: The coach said, “You need to practise.” Must need change to needed?
items.feedback_zh: 引號中是當時說話，可保留現在式。
items.hint_zh: 找出結果、感受及所學；再檢查是否回應故事，動詞是否配合時間。

items.prompt: Add a feeling and a reason: “She felt ___ because ___.” The story is about reading clearly to elderly people.
items.answer: Sample: She felt pleased because everyone could hear her story.
items.feedback_zh: 感受及原因需完整、合理並與故事相關。
items.hint_zh: 找出結果、感受及所學；再檢查是否回應故事，動詞是否配合時間。

items.prompt: Write one lesson for a child who asked for help after making mistakes at a book stall.
items.answer: Sample: He learnt that asking for help could make his work easier.
items.feedback_zh: 可接受其他相關所學；不可只寫 He learnt that 而未完成句子。
items.hint_zh: 找出結果、感受及所學；再檢查是否回應故事，動詞是否配合時間。

items.prompt: Before submitting a past-tense story, choose the best check.
items.answer: Check the timeline, verb patterns, clear result and complete lesson.
items.feedback_zh: 優先檢查時間線、搭配、因果及結尾。
options: Change every word to the past, including all dialogue.
Check the timeline, verb patterns, clear result and complete lesson.
Add difficult words without checking their meaning.
items.hint_zh: 找出結果、感受及所學；再檢查是否回應故事，動詞是否配合時間。
